correctness.rationale: The partition lattice proper part has 201 partitions and shellable order complex wedge 120 S3. The explicitly given two distinct reflection-fixed proper partitions generate D6 as normal point stabilizers, proving the quotient simply connected via Armstrong. Independently enumerated all 201 partitions, 1865 edges, 4245 triangles, 2700 3-flags and their 12-element dihedral orbits: cellular vector (35,215,419,250). Rank-order flags have no inversions; exact integer boundary operators square to zero. Independently performed 34,181,238 unit pivots in degrees 1,2,3, reducing the chain groups to (1,0,0,12) with zero maps. Hurewicz/Whitehead give wedge of 12 S3; no prime-field torsion inference. The finite complex is exhaustively enumerated from its definition.
